verdict.rationale: Salv is an AML compliance platform, so an approval gate on regulatory report filing is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions regulatory report submission (e.g., SAR/STR filing) or any approval workflow for one. Case management with an assignee and status, and AI insights that never close alerts, are adjacent features, not an authorized-approval requirement before external submission.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can require an authorized human approval before an externally submitted regulatory report
